title: Framework-Centric Packaging Schemes
damaged_code:
```rust
// Organizing source files by framework layers instead of domain components
src/
  controllers/
    user_controller.rs
  models/
    user_model.rs
  views/
    user_view.rs
```
pattern: Organizing the physical project directory and package structure strictly by technical framework layers (e.g., MVC folders: `controllers`, `models`, `views`) rather than by business domain components.
why_bad: It destroys the spatial cohesion of business domain components, forcing developers to edit files across multiple disparate directories to implement a single business feature.
detection: A root directory layout partitioned by technical stereotypes (`controllers/`, `views/`, `daos/`) rather than business domains (`billing/`, `shipping/`).
counterexample: A small project (less than 10 source files) where a technical folder layout is used to bootstrap development.
fix: Organize code by domain components (Package by Component), keeping all classes representing a single business concept in the same package.
